scope: blush only; not whole makeup completion

cases.expected: Twelve original patterns at identical colour and strength differ spatially; measured frontal face, both cheeks, no eye/lip pixels altered.
Strength 0 produces byte-identical float input, no native load; monotonic contribution 0.25/0.5/1 with no compositing twice.
Each pattern exposes its own recommended colours; selecting pattern does not overwrite custom colour.

Eyedropper capture requires actual painted producer frame; reject switched photo, changed epoch/revision, changed target/analysis, stale click and cancelled frame; only matching working-sRGB float sample applies one colour patch.
RGB and HEX agree; malformed, partial, negative, noninteger, >255 and nonfinite values reject atomically; drafts do not mutate image.
Six unique favourites persist save/reopen and history; seventh refuses without eviction; remove then add works; duplicate is idempotent.
Known hair/clothes/background, eyes, lips and outside-face support are exactly zero. Real hand/glasses overlap reviewed and corrected with blush-only recovery; do not claim full occlusion detection.
Two real people have independent pattern, amount and colour. Source/landmark evidence mismatch and synthetic/manual points reject. One refused requested face refuses full publication.

Original RGB16 fine ramps survive unquantized; neutral HDR contract unaffected; active out-of-working-range input refuses, never silently clamps input. GPU/CPU parity and tile seams require measurement.
Recovery on blush removes only blush before/after contribution; old immutable vectors survive undo/redo/reopen; face or source mismatch refuses.

Batch/preset transfers scalar intent only through reviewed canonical mappings and frozen receipts; destination recomputes support; no copied face IDs/masks/recovery or palette; stale preflight refuses.
Full-source export solves each face once and crops all tile edges; original-source and repaired float anchors frozen; low-memory refuses rather than proxy/downsample/skip.
Project/history deeply reject corrupt colours, catalogues, unknown pattern, dormant overrides or missing native artifact; old files without blush remain neutral.
UI keyboard/tab order, partial HEX/RGB drafts, Enter, double-click, collapse/reopen, pending edits, uncertain receipts, Escape and tool switch remain safe; no success inferred from control motion.

Load matched undeformed source preview, paint and confirm both cheeks; immutable review assets enter canonical support bank and survive undo/redo/reopen. Missing, single-cheek, stale source/analysis or tampered review refuses active blush. Review never overrides actual skin, eyes/lips or known-occluder exclusions.

fixture_policy: Native numeric cases use synthetic float arrays only. Visual acceptance requires independently licensed real portraits with recorded consent/source and model hashes; none fabricated or downloaded during this task.
